questions: Are the movements in your right hand involuntary?
Do the movements vary substantially from moment to moment?
Do they decrease or stop when you are distracted?
Can you voluntarily keep the hand completely still?
Do you feel an urge or inner tension before the movement that is relieved afterward?
Can you briefly suppress the movement?
Do the movements occur during sleep?
Do you have similar involuntary movements in your face, mouth, tongue, or other limbs?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication?
Have you taken antipsychotic, anti-nausea, antidepressant, stimulant, or seizure medicines for a prolonged period?
Do you have weakness or numbness on the right side?
Have you had difficulty speaking, understanding speech, seeing, walking, or keeping your balance?
Have you had episodes of loss of awareness, staring, or memory gaps with these movements?
Have you previously had a stroke, brain injury, seizure, or other neurological illness?
